desc: Prism Shell: the support-fighter that turns shots around. Units: seconds, metres, hp.
name: Prism Shell

look.why: a crystal shell about 20% wider than you

shell_why: x1.1: a little more than base

baseline.why: run-speed bonus by weight class (a light hero keeps the most speed; merge cap +40%)

r.name: Shatter
r.desc: The shell cracks, then bursts outward, hurting foes and shielding your squad.
r.why: 0.55s of cracking with a 6.8m ground marker, then a burst: 40 dmg + stun to foes, a 70 hp shield for allies within 8m

lmb.name: Crystal Shards
lmb.desc: Every hit sends piercing crystal shards through foes and slows them.

rmb.name: Prism Burst
rmb.desc: Your right click also throws a ring of crystals that slows foes and shields you. Recharges 20% faster.

e.name: Prism Pulse
e.desc: Your E also pulses a shield to your squad. Recharges 20% faster.

dash.name: Mirror Step
dash.desc: A short reflect window while you dash: shots that hit it fly back.

aug_why: the augment set of this Boki type, identical for every hero: LMB rider, RMB and E add-on effects, the form dash and a modest passive
